name: carddemo-tests
description: cobolget manifest for the AWS CardDemo test suite. Declares GCBLUnit as a debug/test dependency used to compile and run the COBOL unit tests in tests/cobol-unit/*_test.cbl. NOTE: cobolget's native manifest filename is modules.json; this file is named tests/cobolget.json per the project's test plan (the AAP-mandated name) but follows the cobolget schema. GCBLUnit is ALSO vendored directly as tests/cobol-unit/gcblunit.cbl, so this manifest is primarily a provenance/reproducibility record of the framework version, not a hard runtime dependency. 'modules' is intentionally empty because this project consumes a framework rather than publishing COBOL modules (cobolget publish/validate would require a non-empty list, which is not applicable here).
